summary: A windowed chat history of 40 messages that loads 30 older ones at the top without moving the view.
use: Long conversations where older messages load on scroll and the scroll position must be preserved.
spec: `<VirtualList {items} getKey={(m) => m.id} label="Conversation" height="18rem" {hasMore} loadingMore={loading} onloadmore={loadOlder}>`
`async function loadOlder()` prepends a page of 30 messages with `items = [...page, ...items];`
`<Button size="sm" variant="outlined" onclick={add}>Receive a message</Button>` appends a new row
